name: ai-enterprise-studio
description: AI Enterprise Studio - A fully functional multimedia collaboration platform

scripts.build:all: npm run clean:builds && npm run build:mainstage && npm run build:studio && npm run build:videochat
scripts.deploy:studio: npm run build:studio && firebase deploy --only hosting --project studio -c firebase.studio.json
scripts.deploy:mainstage: npm run build:mainstage && firebase deploy --only hosting --project mainstage -c firebase.mainstage.json
scripts.deploy:videochat: npm run build:videochat && firebase deploy --only hosting --project lobby -c firebase.lobby.json
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:mainstage && npm run deploy:studio && npm run deploy:videochat
